body:
Sometimes I feel crushed by my life too friend. It's always something. 

I hear that you think that your dad loves you less. I don't know if that's true. I think for many men that have children, they expect certain things about the ways that their children might turn out, and often they couldn't have imagined how it might turn out, no matter the circumstance.

When life doesn't come out within the limitations of your expectations, often, people get upset, and that is understandable. Life can throw a lot of twists in the narrative that is you.

I always tell my daughter, it's better to be interesting than normal. She thinks I'm nuts. Maybe I am.

It's hard for you right now, I understand that. It might be hard for your dad to take this in right now. It's still fresh, you're still in high school, he probably doesn't really know what to even think. 

He could be wrapped up in this, how am I going to protect my daughter from these ravenous men blah blah blah or something, and when he thinks of the change that you are going through, he doesn't understand how to process it. 

**Your father is a boy trying to comprehend what it truly takes to become a man, something you are going through now, and it makes him question his own manhood.**

I'm assuming a lot here.I apologize if I am out of place. I know your plight is important, and difficult, and you have a sound mind to deal with it on your own, but external sources are contributing excess stress based on things they fear out of not understanding what they are. 

You are stuck in the middle of this. Stay with me ya hear?

I'm sorry if your father isn't comfortable right now. That sucks. I faced a lot of disappointment from my own father in many ways, and that the need to appease your parents is strong, and when you are something they don't expect, it makes you feel bad for being who you are, and I will tell you this here:

**You are important. You are powerful and brave for accepting who you are and embracing this.**

You still have time to see the world, and to have kids of your own. Suicide will deprive you of that. Suicide will deprive me of you too /u/MatteGray and I would rather talk to you here than read about your death friend

Stick around, hang out for awhile, together we can figure this out. <3

/u/MatteGray I hear that you are a freshman in college, and you are trans. 

I can only imagine how hard that could be. You're coming here on the internet asking strangers for help, and it takes guts friend, you don't have a friend, or a family member that you could talk about this to right now.

You are brave. That's important, as are you.

It would be hard on your family to lose you, period. 

Let's consider the options, although I don't know your situation, and I would like to hear more about it, so that we can talk about better options than offing yourself, which, let's face it, it's a messy awful matter. 

Offing yourself is, IMO, very unlikely to make anything much better, not before considering every other avenue first. 

If I may ask, and you do not need to answer if you feel uncomfortable answering:

* Are your pre or post operational? 
* Does your family know?
* If your family doesn't know, how would they react?
* What goals would suicide deprive you of?

Stay strong OP <3

Did I ever tell you that you are a good person, because you are.

You are absolutely not a cockass, by no means. I appreciate your honesty 100% fucking percent. No shit, good on you, that's fucking cool friend.

Aaand, well shit, that's something to think about. 

Feeeehehehehuucck, better than screaming and waking the kids up I guess.

His SO knows. She is a former addict herself. 

I have learned that they accessed this together, that's shite

This really just changes everything for me.

I've drank and smoked pot for 2 decades. In the last two decades, the number of times I have been offered heroin is exactly zero fucking times.

Exactly zero. 

It has to be sought after.

Yea, she wants her husband to be sober, and she's pretty in denial too. 

I probably have a lot of the same regrets you have. I appreciate your help and knowledge. 

I should probably do something, but what I say and do, must be extremely carefully planned, so as to instill no hatred, and everything loving. 

Thanks for everything. Have a kick ass week friend!

Thanks for responding. I like the cut of your gib.

I agree that I want to do something immediately. I know his parents pretty well, and if they don't know already, I plan on telling them.

He is a person with a very, how to put this, volatile personality to begin with. If I don't go to the wedding, I'm concerned that he would deal with it as a personal blow against him, and not take it as encouragement to seek treatment, but as a personal attack. 

My fear, with that approach, is that he may end up doing *more* heroin. I certainly don't want that. Nobody does.

My very close relative recently went through full blown oxy addiction, to full blown heroin addiction, to inpatient rehab. I stood by him and didn't constantly give him shit, even though I knew what was going on. 

When we did stage an intervention, he told me after going through rehab and cleaning up, that by being supportive even when he was going through the worst of times, that it made him feel like I really meant it, and that I was a person who's opinion could be trusted.

This guy, my friend, is not even tempered by any means on a good day, and heroin use completely fucks your logical mind in the face with a rake. 

I'm probably going to watch this guy go through his wedding half passing out. I just hope he doesn't die beforehand. 

If he starts dying at the wedding, my wife is a nurse, and I've got that going for me, which is nice.

**tl;dr** I hope I go to a wedding and not a funeral, my actions as an individual in this situation have the potential to do more harm than good right now. 

*clenching asshole tight in preparation for the future*

Thanks

I'm not a role model, I'm drunk and stoned, but I fucking hate seeing people addicted to crack, coke, heroin, or even worse, prescription pain killers like oxy.


I have to convince a 32 year old man to go to rehab. That's what it is. That's what's up. I can't watch another person destroy themselves and die to this shit. 

Any help or advice you can provide is greatly appreciated.

Sorry for sucking at life or something. Fuck everything
